profile.name: XIA DXP 多道 X 射线能谱映射系统
profile.name_en: XIA DXP X-ray Spectroscopy Mapping System
profile.description: 这是一类基于 DXP 数字脉冲处理器和 MCA 多道分析器的 X 射线能谱采集系统，常与单通道或多通道探测器配合使用。它用于采集能谱、进行多元素或多像素映射测量，并在同步辐射与实验室 X 射线实验中支持 X 射线荧光等能量色散谱学应用。
profile.description_en: This is an X-ray spectroscopy acquisition system based on DXP digital pulse processors and MCA multichannel analyzers, typically used with single-element or multi-element detectors. It is used to collect energy spectra, perform multi-element or pixel-by-pixel mapping measurements, and support energy-dispersive spectroscopy applications such as X-ray fluorescence in synchrotron and laboratory X-ray experiments.

registry.name: Epics Dxp Mapping X射线衍射仪
registry.description: Epics Dxp Mapping X射线衍射仪是由EPICS (Argonne National Lab)生产的X射线衍射仪，主要功能包括停止。支持Signal, Slot, add rois等操作。
